title: Settings structure
change: Seven main destinations, with clear task headings and return routes. The repeated static clock preview and universal saved badge are removed; actions give their own feedback.

title: Light, Dark and Automatic
change: The three modes are visible choices. Palette and mode remain independent; Automatic still follows offline sunrise/sunset at the configured city.

title: Text size
change: Standard and Larger text are visible alternatives. The palette gallery stays visual; there is no dropdown for a two-option decision.

title: Dashboard editor
change: The editor opens a dedicated canvas workspace. Coordinates, Arrange neatly, preview-resolution selection and Expand canvas are removed. The canvas follows the current display proportions; a selected widget shows relevant choices.

title: Starting layouts
change: Balanced, Photos first and Plans first become visual template cards. Choosing one stages a draft; it applies only when Apply layout is pressed. Adding a widget no longer silently rearranges the existing layout.

title: Clock styles
change: Landscape, Analog, Flip and Botanical show actual responsive clock compositions. Changing style is staged with the layout.

title: Draft recovery
change: Permanent Undo/Redo buttons leave the main toolbar. Recent changes is available while a layout is dirty. Close, Back, backdrop and category changes ask Apply, Discard or Keep editing; failed saves retain the draft.

title: Page visibility
change: Optional sidebar pages and Overview favourite preference live together under Dashboard → Pages. Household is an explicit optional destination.

title: Momo wardrobe policy
change: Keep one look, A new look each day and Surprise me are distinct visible policies. Motion and daily rhythm are visible choices rather than mixed with accessories.

title: Momo accessory gallery
change: One illustrated gallery chooses the accessory. Random rotation gets a contextual Try another accessory action; the duplicate accessory dropdown is removed.

title: City, units and clock format
change: City search remains a focused task under Frame. Temperature units and 12/24-hour format become visible two-option choices; the app retains configured timezone behavior.

title: Photos landing
change: Photos opens understandable task destinations instead of a long stack of forms: library, slideshow, collections, review, delivery, retention, import, presentations and temporary phone connection. Shared-album mode shows its supported tasks.

title: Gallery browsing
change: Pictures are the primary interaction. Tap a picture to edit it. Permanent checkboxes and repeated Edit buttons are removed from normal browsing.

title: Gallery selection
change: Select pictures starts an explicit batch mode; Done selecting returns to browsing. Keep, favourite, exclude, restore and collection membership appear when selection is active.

title: Picture editing
change: A focused picture task leads with a large crop preview. Rotate is a direct action, framing uses visible choices, and metadata sits in Photo information. Captions stay off the player; existing stored text is preserved.

title: Direct crop
change: Dragging the picture chooses Fill and stages crop position and framing together. Save applies the draft; navigation uses the same dependable departure guard. Custom viewing time remains available on demand.

title: Slideshow presentation
change: All five styles become illustrated choices with restrained animated samples: Soft fade, Falling prints, Photo collage, Gentle pan & zoom and Still gallery. Preview presentation opens the real player.

title: Viewing pace
change: Common viewing times are visible presets. Another viewing time preserves arbitrary existing values, such as 15 minutes, without forcing them to a preset.

title: Composition and framing
change: Layout and background are visual choices. Fit and Fill demonstrate their effect using an eligible local picture. Transition refinement is a separate disclosure; reduced-motion behavior remains in force.

title: Transition refinement
change: Transition timing has named defaults, with visual type choices. These controls appear only when Fine-tune transitions is opened.

title: Collections and order
change: Collection cards show the pictures that will play, including favourites and user collections. Excluded pictures are removed from card previews. Order is visible; conditional shuffle weighting and manual arrangement appear when relevant.

title: Receiving photos
change: Source choice is visible. Delivery frequency saves independently of credential entry; trusted-sender fields appear only when enabled, with an explicit Apply sender rule action. Account connection is a disclosure with empty credential fields.

title: Retention and exclusions
change: Last 30 days, Last 90 days, Last 30 photos and Last 100 photos are foregrounded. Other retention windows remain available on demand. Received-date rules, capacity, Keepers and persistent exclusions are explained together; erase remains deliberate.

title: Arrival review
change: Review, capture-date policy and storage feedback move to their own task. Existing approval and rejection behavior is retained; private image metadata is not invented.

title: Import and soundtrack
change: Picture and muted-clip import are clear task actions. Optional soundtrack details and volume appear only when needed. Native format/capacity/privacy boundaries remain unchanged.

title: Saved presentations
change: Saved presentations are visual cards. Creation is an explicit disclosure; removal requires a second tap. Seasonal options use named months; title/video-export refinements remain available on demand.

title: Temporary phone connection
change: Phone curation gets a focused destination. QR invitation, matching-number approval and immediate Stop retain their existing temporary encrypted behavior.

title: Daily routine
change: Automatic photo delay, schedule, app brightness and quiet/privacy behavior are grouped under Frame → Daily routine. Common idle delays are visible choices; detailed schedules remain available.

title: Household content
change: Household is reached from the dashboard workspace. Notes remain local; countdown creation appears under Add a date instead of competing with existing content.

title: Calendars
change: Connected calendars and visibility are primary. Connect another calendar is a deliberate disclosure, with visual colour choices. Secret feed fields retain the direct read-only integration and never appear in public screenshots.

title: Inviter review
change: Pending decisions and approved organizers precede setup. Review policy and account setup remain in a disclosure; the screen states that these are frame-only display decisions.

title: Apps
change: Google Home leads with Open Google Home. The connection URL lives under Connection details. YouTube shortcuts are a separate task; opening a service is not described as verified sign-in or control.

title: YouTube shortcuts
change: Title/link entry has its own task reached from Apps. It remains optional and separate from page visibility.

title: Frame
change: City/time, Daily routine and Software updates become a short task list. Android Wi-Fi, developer options and app switching retain direct recovery shortcuts.

title: Update policy
change: Manual, Notify me, Download and Install when idle are mutually understandable policies. Existing overnight windows remain intact; the window and permission actions appear when relevant. The desktop preview remains explicit about native installation limits.

title: Help and maintenance
change: Coarse service health, settings links, setup help and recovery remain together. Healthy services say Refresh; failures say Retry. Routine personalization no longer competes with maintenance.

title: Preference transfer
change: Export/choose-file replaces the permanent raw JSON form. Android uses its document picker. Valid imports show a non-secret review before Apply; Cancel preserves the original settings. Accounts, photos, links, content and custom layout are excluded.
